statement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ), 2 ≤ m → 2 ≤ k → k ≤ n → (∀ i : ℕ, i < n → 0 ≤ x i) → (∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ j → j < n → x j ≤ x i) → (1 : ℝ) ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun i : ℕ => (x i) ^ m) → Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun i : ℕ => x i) ≤ (k : ℝ) → (1 : ℝ) ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.range k) (fun i : ℕ => x i)
proofTerm:
by
  intro m n k x hm hk hkn hxnonneg hmono hpower hsum
  let t : ℝ := Finset.sum (Finset.range k) (fun i : ℕ => x i)
  let u : ℝ := x (k - 1)
  change (1 : ℝ) ≤ t
  by_contra hnot
  have htlt : t < 1 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hk1_lt_n : k - 1 < n := by omega
  have hk1_lt_k : k - 1 < k := by omega
  have hk1_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact hxnonneg (k - 1) hk1_lt_n
  have hfront_term_nonneg : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range k, 0 ≤ x j := by
    intro j hj
    exact hxnonneg j (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hj) hkn)
  have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (s := Finset.range k) (f := fun j : ℕ => x j) hfront_term_nonneg
  have hfront_bounds : ∀ i, i < k → u ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ t := by
    intro i hi
    constructor
    · dsimp [u]
      exact hmono i (k - 1) (by omega) hk1_lt_n
    · dsimp [t]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.range k) (f := fun j : ℕ => x j) (a := i) hfront_term_nonneg (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi)
  have htail_bounds : ∀ i, k ≤ i → i < n → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u := by
    intro i hki hin
    constructor
    · exact hxnonneg i hin
    · dsimp [u]
      exact hmono (k - 1) i (by omega) hin
  have hall_bounds : ∀ i, i < n → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i < 1 := by
    intro i hin
    constructor
    · exact hxnonneg i hin
    · by_cases hik : i < k
      · have hif := hfront_bounds i hik
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hif.2 htlt
      · have hki : k ≤ i := by omega
        have hit := htail_bounds i hki hin
        have hle_u : x i ≤ u := hit.2
        have hu_le_t : u ≤ t := by
          have hk1k := hfront_bounds (k - 1) hk1_lt_k
          exact hk1k.2
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans hle_u hu_le_t) htlt
  have source_step_0 : (0 ≤ t ∧ t < 1 ∧ 0 ≤ u ∧ u < 1 ∧
      (∀ i, i < n → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i < 1) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → u ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ t) ∧
      (∀ i, k ≤ i → i < n → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u)) := by
    refine ⟨ht_nonneg, htlt, hk1_nonneg, ?_, hall_bounds, hfront_bounds, htail_bounds⟩
    have hk1k := hfront_bounds (k - 1) hk1_lt_k
    dsimp [u]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hk1k.2 htlt
  have source_step_1 : ∀ i, i < n → (x i) ^ m ≤ (x i) ^ 2 := by
    intro i hin
    have hb := hall_bounds i hin
    have h0 : 0 ≤ x i := hb.1
    have hlt : x i < 1 := hb.2
    have hle1 : x i ≤ 1 := le_of_lt hlt
    have hdecomp : m = 2 + (m - 2) := by omega
    have hpow_le_one : (x i) ^ (m - 2) ≤ 1 := by
      exact pow_le_one₀ h0 hle1
    calc
      (x i) ^ m = (x i) ^ (2 + (m - 2)) := by
        exact congrArg (fun e : ℕ => (x i) ^ e) hdecomp
      _ = (x i) ^ 2 * (x i) ^ (m - 2) := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≤ (x i) ^ 2 * 1 := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le_one (sq_nonneg (x i))
      _ = (x i) ^ 2 := by ring
  have source_step_2 : ((∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m) ≤ u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, x i) ∧
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m) ≤ u * ((k : ℝ) - t)) := by
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m ≤ u * x i := by
      intro i hi
      have hki : k ≤ i := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1
      have hin : i < n := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2
      have hstep1 : (x i) ^ m ≤ (x i) ^ 2 := source_step_1 i hin
      have htb := htail_bounds i hki hin
      have hsq : (x i) ^ 2 ≤ u * x i := by
        calc
          (x i) ^ 2 = x i * x i := by ring
          _ ≤ u * x i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htb.2 htb.1
      exact le_trans hstep1 hsq
    have hsum_pow_le : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m) ≤ u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, x i) := by
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, u * x i := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
        _ = u * (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, x i) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have htail_x_le : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, x i) ≤ (k : ℝ) - t := by
      have hdecomp : t + (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, x i) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x i := by
        dsimp [t]
        rw [Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico (fun i : ℕ => x i) hkn]
      linarith
    have hsum_pow_le' : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m) ≤ u * ((k : ℝ) - t) := by
      exact le_trans hsum_pow_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail_x_le hk1_nonneg)
    exact ⟨hsum_pow_le, hsum_pow_le'⟩
  have source_step_3 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i) ^ m) ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i) ^ m ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by
      intro i hi
      have hik : i < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      have hfb := hfront_bounds i hik
      have hu_le_x : u ≤ x i := hfb.1
      have hx_le_t : x i ≤ t := hfb.2
      have hx_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hx_le_t htlt
      have hprod : (x i - u) * (x i - 1) ≤ 0 := by
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hsq : (x i) ^ 2 ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by nlinarith [hprod]
      have hin : i < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hik hkn
      exact le_trans (source_step_1 i hin) hsq
    have hsum_le : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i) ^ m) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i - u + u * x i) := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    have hsum_eq : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i - u + u * x i)) = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
      dsimp [t]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [show (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, u) = (k : ℝ) * u by
        simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i) ^ m) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i - u + u * x i) := hsum_le
      _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := hsum_eq
  have source_step_4 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x i) ^ m) ≤ t := by
    have hdecomp : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i) ^ m) + (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x i) ^ m := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico (fun i : ℕ => (x i) ^ m) hkn]
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x i) ^ m) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (x i) ^ m) + (∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k n, (x i) ^ m) := hdecomp.symm
      _ ≤ (t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t) + u * ((k : ℝ) - t) := add_le_add source_step_3 source_step_2.2
      _ = t := by ring
  have source_step_5 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ t := by
    linarith [hpower, source_step_4]
  exact hnot source_step_5

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 第一步（设反证条件，并验证界限）：令 t=x₁+x₂+⋯+xₖ，u=xₖ。反设 t<1。因所有 xᵢ≥0，且 x₁≥⋯≥xₙ，所以 0≤u≤xᵢ≤t<1 对 1≤i≤k 成立；对 k<i≤n，则 0≤xᵢ≤u<1。特别地，0≤u<1，且 t≥0。另外对全部 i=1,…,n 有 0≤xᵢ<1：前 k 项不超过 t，后 n−k 项不超过 u。整个反证推导中分母没有出现，n=k 时后段求和约定为 0。
第二步（低于 1 的非负数降幂）：由于 m≥2 为整数，对任意 0≤s<1，均有 s^m≤s²。这是因为 m−2 为非负整数且 0≤s^(m−2)≤1，故 s^m=s²·s^(m−2)≤s²（若 m=2，则 s^(m−2)=1）。将此结论分别用于每个 xᵢ。

第三步（尾段估计）：对每个 k<i≤n，有 0≤xᵢ≤u，故 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²≤u xᵢ。逐项求和得到
∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m≤u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ。
又由条件（ii）以及前 k 项的和为 t，有 ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ≤k−t。因为 u≥0，所以
∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m≤u(k−t)。
n=k 时两边的尾段求和均为 0，结论依然成立。

第四步（前段估计）：对每个 1≤i≤k，由第一步有 u≤xᵢ<1，因此 (xᵢ−u)≥0、(xᵢ−1)≤0，从而 (xᵢ−u)(xᵢ−1)≤0。
展开整理即得 xᵢ²≤(1+u)xᵢ−u=xᵢ−u+u xᵢ。
结合第二步 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²，得到
xᵢ^m≤xᵢ−u+u xᵢ。
对 i=1,…,k 求和得
∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m≤t−ku+ut。

第五步（合并不等式并产生矛盾）：将幂和拆成前 k 项和后 n−k 项，利用第三、四步，
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
=∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤(t−ku+ut)+u(k−t)
=t。
但题设（i）给出 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1，因此有 1≤t，与反设 t<1 矛盾。
反设不成立，故 t≥1，即 x₁+x₂+⋯+xₖ≥1。证毕。
